text: Overview aligned to origin/dev b5ad575. This is a modular monolith: one Next.js application, one Spring Boot application, one PostgreSQL database, and external integrations.

text: SePay webhook verifies HMAC signature and timestamp, locates the AU payment code, then marks the booking paid. VNPay uses checkout, browser return, IPN, and query synchronization. Payment confirmation changes PENDING to CONFIRMED and assigns staff.
Only a CONFIRMED booking can create a wash session; each lifecycle mutation broadcasts a wash-session event.
